Name: Simple Forage Digging
Author: Xsyy
Description:
[center][size=6][b][color=#D8B4FE]✦ Simple Forage Digging ✦[/color][/b][/size][/center]

[center][color=#67E8F9][b]Your forage perks, even underground.[/b][/color]
Dig up forage with the quality your skills deserve. Snow Yams, Winter Roots, Cave Carrots and Ginger use your normal forage-quality calculation, including forage found in artifact spots.[/center]

[center][size=4][b][color=#FDE68A]🌱 How It Works[/color][/b][/size][/center]

[center]• [b][color=#D8B4FE]Botanist[/color][/b] gives qualifying dug-up forage iridium quality.
• Without Botanist, normal forage-quality rolls apply.
• [b][color=#86EFAC]Simple Skills Extended[/color][/b] is optional: its enabled forage-quality bonuses apply when earned. Both Level 100 and Level 30 editions are supported, with each edition retaining its own rewards.
• Uses the farmer doing the digging and preserves existing iridium or higher custom quality.
• Original quantities, item data and XP remain unchanged. Artifacts, ore, clay and seeds are unaffected.[/center]

[center][size=4][b][color=#67E8F9]🤝 Simple Forage Helper[/color][/b][/size][/center]

[center]SFH's artifact-spot forage benefits from the collector owner's perks, and its storage retains that quality. Ordinary loose forage already uses those perks. SFD does not add new SFH collection abilities, such as digging empty winter soil or harvesting Ginger.[/center]

[center][size=4][b][color=#86EFAC]📦 Install & Play[/color][/b][/size][/center]

[center]Requires [b]Stardew Valley 1.6 on PC[/b] and [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI 4.0 or newer[/url]. Extract SimpleForageDigging into your Mods folder and launch through SMAPI.
Works automatically in any game language. No configuration, GMCM, hotkey or new menu is required. SSE and SFH are optional.
To uninstall, remove SimpleForageDigging; existing item quality remains.[/center]

[center][size=4][b][color=#D8B4FE]🔎 Testing & Feedback[/color][/b][/size][/center]

[center]26 native-game checks passed with each SSE edition, including pickup quality, nested digging and disabled SSE bonuses. Live gameplay has not yet been verified.
For issues, include what you dug up, your perks and a [url=https://smapi.io/log]SMAPI log[/url].
[color=#FDE68A]Made by xSyy • Version 1.0[/color][/center]
